rules.licence: Sea fishing needs no licence, but this is the Fiordland Marine Area: inside the fiords ten finfish a day all told, one sea perch, one tarakihi (25 cm or more), and no blue cod may be taken in Milford Sound's internal waters. Trout at the Cleddau's mouth are sports fish: a Fish & Game licence, carried, and two a day.
rules.release: Every fish here goes back: the game keeps a log, not a bag.

zones.name: The head of the fiord
zones.advice: At the head, where the Cleddau runs in, the fiord's limits hold for sea fish, and a trout is two a day on a Fish & Game licence.

zones.name: Milford Sound's internal waters
zones.advice: Inside the fiord: one sea perch and one tarakihi a day, ten finfish all told, and every blue cod goes back.

reserves.name: Piopiotahi (Milford Sound) Marine Reserve
reserves.why: This is the Piopiotahi Marine Reserve, along the north wall from the village to Dale Point: no fishing of any kind. Lines in until she is clear of it.
reserves.note: 690 ha, established 1993 (Marine Reserve (Piopiotahi (Milford Sound)) Order 1993). The seaward boundary A to F is DOC's (WGS84, map of 13 August 2024); land_xy closes it back to A over the north wall's land, points picked on the model's ground (all above the water).

rigs.name: Squid on the bottom
rigs.hint: A strip of squid on a running sinker, let down the wall's edge for perch, tarakihi and cod.

rigs.name: Small bright spinner
rigs.hint: Cast out and wound back through the Cleddau's water, for a sea-run trout.

rigs.name: Soft plastic, jigged
rigs.hint: Hopped off the bottom close to the rock, where the fish hold.

species.name: Sea perch (jock stewart)

legal.bag_note: one a day inside the fiords

species.note: A scorpionfish, spines and all, red and mottled: the fish most often hooked on the bottom in the fiords. Handle it by the jaw.

species.name: Blue cod (rawaru)

legal.closed: No blue cod may be taken from Milford Sound's internal waters
legal.bag_note: closed in Milford Sound's internal waters

species.note: Curious and greedy, and few in this fiord: Fisheries New Zealand closed Milford Sound to taking them for their low numbers and the poor habitat. Every one goes back.

species.name: Tarakihi

legal.bag_note: one a day inside the fiords, 25 cm or more

species.note: Silver with a black saddle behind the head, and a small mouth that picks at the bait before it takes.

species.name: Sea-run brown trout

legal.bag_note: two trout a day, on a Fish & Game licence

species.note: Browns that go down the Cleddau to feed in the fiord and come back silver. They hunt the edge of the river's fresh water, best on a dropping light and after rain.

spots.name: The foreshore at the head
spots.note: The walk along the head of the fiord, where the Cleddau's fresh water runs out over the salt. Sea-run trout hunt along its edge.
spots.source: Fish & Game, 2026/27 South Island regulations (Southland: waters draining to the Tasman Sea west of the Waiau, open all year, two trout a day)

spots.name: The Piopiotahi's after deck
spots.note: Off the stern while she cruises, a line let down the wall's edge. She passes the marine reserve under the north wall: lines in there.
spots.source: Fisheries New Zealand, Fiordland Marine Area fishing rules
